gateC_verdict: NOT PASSED. 4 metrics PASS (fall_rate, ep_len, vx_track_err, base_h, no NaN/Inf); 3 metrics FAIL (joint_pos_err_ref 0.462>0.30, dof_limit_viol 30776>0, Sim2Sim not run). The stability/walking-task groups are strong and reproducible across 5 seeds; imitation quality (joint-pos error) and safety (joint-limit violations) do not meet frozen thresholds. Per amp_loop.md §6/§11 no-threshold-lowering rule, Gate C is NOT passed.

analysis.stability_task: EXCELLENT: 0 falls in 20 episodes (5 seeds x 4), full 24s episodes (2401 steps), tight velocity tracking (vx_err 0.144-0.159 tracking 0.5 m/s). The policy learned stable forward walking -- this is a real AMP walking result, not a standstill.
analysis.imitation_quality_gap: joint_pos_err_ref=0.462 rad consistently across all 5 seeds (std ~0). The policy walks stably but does NOT closely track the reference clip's joint trajectory. Plausible causes (one-variable-per-experiment per §11): (a) AMP style reward weight too low vs task rewards -> stable-but-not-imitative gait (training tracking_lin_vel reward 1.11 is large, style contribution small); (b) retargeted reference has a systematic offset (IK residual 0.124m) shifted into joint space; (c) jp_err metric compares policy dof_pos against the reference at episode-frame index, but the policy's gait phase is not aligned to the reference phase -> inflated even for a good walker.
analysis.safety_gap: dof_limit_viol_total=30776 over 20 episodes is large. The env has soft termination on base roll/pitch>1.5 and contact, but NOT on joint-limit hard violations, so the policy can ride the joint limits during swing. The training dof_pos_limits penalty (-0.185) is nonzero every iter. This is a real safety concern for deployment (Sim2Sim/real) even though no fall occurs.
next_directions_structural: Increase AMP style-reward weight / decrease task-reward scale so imitation dominates (single-variable change vs current run); re-eval jp_err.
Add joint-limit hard termination OR stiffer dof_pos_limits penalty so dof_viol->0 (safety gate item); re-eval dof_viol.
Re-examine the jp_err metric: phase-align policy gait to reference before comparing (the constant 0.46 across seeds suggests a phase/offset artifact, not random noise).
